lines.t: Tired of pretending Caught in the act, it's never ending
So many secrets locked away But you see through every layer, every day
I kept the walls up high, afraid to let you inside
But you just wait, always patient, wanting me unfiltered, never faking
Every time I fall, you're still beside me, every hidden thought you already know
When I can't stand tall, I hear you remind me, your mercy's wide as oceans flow
So here's my heart, every scar, every part Giving you my truth, no more playing hard

I tried to earn it, tried to be flawless for you
